## Description

Computes the size of the downloaded deposit and writes it, in MB, to the Jira issue's "Deposit size" field, overwriting any earlier value. The work is done by `tools/jira_update_deposit_size.py`. It must run before the deposit ZIP is moved away (for example into `cache/`), so that the tool can still see it.

The Jira ticket is taken from `$jiraticket`, then `config.yml`, then looked up from an openICPSR directory.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/27_update_jira_deposit_size.sh <project-dir>
```

The exit code is that of the Python tool; the pipelines append `|| true`.

### Environment Variables

- `jiraticket`, `JIRA_USERNAME`, `JIRA_API_KEY`
